The manuscript does not clearly identify the novel attack condition or theoretical insight beyond existing results.

rows.text:
In deriving (42), the manuscript claims that \(D_s\neq0\), \(D_s\geq0\), full row rank of \(Z_s\), and \(\Theta_s^{-1}>0\) imply
$$
\operatorname{tr}(\Theta_s^{-1}Z_sD_sZ_s^\top)>0.
$$
However, these conditions alone do not guarantee \(Z_sD_sZ_s^\top\neq0\). An additional condition is required for strict positivity. Since this property is essential to establishing the K-L statistic divergence in Theorem 2, the proof requires substantial reconsideration.
